## Phase: 70 - Single-Decision Anchor-Headroom Screen

### Anchor selection is upstream of measurement — screen for existence before building anything
from: [[amplifier-anchor-headroom-screen]]
retrieved: 2026-05-30

- Phase 69 left the live off/on run blocked for TWO independent structural reasons: the detector is blind (anchor surfaces in prose, 0 in-AUQ events) AND the anchor is degenerate (base model handles look-ahead unprompted in the OFF baseline — raw OFF 11/22/30 ≥ ON 4/8/6). Predicate-repair-first is structurally BLOCKED: any boundary broadened to catch the current anchor in ON also catches it in OFF ⇒ raw-text collapse, discriminates nothing. You cannot repair the detector until you know WHERE a valid anchor surfaces.
- So Phase 70 inverts the handoff order and screens anchor EXISTENCE first (Approach A, user-chosen 2026-05-30): does ANY non-commodity single-decision pure-reasoning anchor have real OFF-baseline headroom? This is also the cheapest go/no-go for the whole amplifier program (5 negative phases — the Phase-59→61→69 commodity-knowledge lesson at rising generality: the strong base model leaves little measurable headroom).

### The five fixes that keep this from being the 6th negative meta-phase
from: [[amplifier-anchor-headroom-screen]] + the adversarial approach review (un-fixed design = 4/10)
retrieved: 2026-05-30

- (1) DETERMINISTIC consensus criterion, NOT a judge: named-clause regex/structural check; HAS-HEADROOM iff FAILS ≥4/5 with the SAME clause-id, DEGENERATE iff PASSES ≥4/5, else UNSTABLE/quarantine. Consensus-by-clause not OR-of-failures — OR + run-noise inflates false HAS-HEADROOM (= false continue, the costliest error; the Phase-58 n=1 false-positive scar). n=5 exactly.
- (2) PURE-REASONING anchors only — a bare subagent ≠ harness-off for tool-users (the confound that retired eval/comparison's A-vs-C arm); restricting to no-tool anchors isolates harness headroom from a subagent capability gap.
- (3) DROP long-horizon/retention — one-shot subagent can't surface multi-turn degradation; deferred to a multi-turn substrate (a null here does NOT close the process-headroom question).
- (4) THREE controls run FIRST (controls-first checkpoint): negative=look-ahead⇒DEGENERATE, positive=unknowable-fact⇒HAS-HEADROOM, middle=known-partial⇒UNSTABLE reproduced on a blind re-run (proves the screen QUARANTINES the contested band, not drifts to false HAS-HEADROOM). Any misbehavior ⇒ STOP, instrument broken.
- (5) GRADED, priors-skeptic-proof verdict: pre-registration (candidates + shasum-pinned OFF prompts + checks + base-model) COMMITTED before runs — T1 commits SEPARATELY before T2/T3 so `git merge-base --is-ancestor <prereg> <first-verdict>` passes. Ladder: natural HAS-HEADROOM⇒CONTINUE (P71 gets the validated anchor); only engineered-favorable⇒PARKED; even engineered DEGENERATE⇒TERMINATE.
